factor_value.evidence: inferred: To isolate 15k EVs, the conditioned medium was centrifuged at 15,000 g for 60 min at 4°C to pellet 15k EVs.
inferred: To isolate 167k EVs, the 15k EV‐depleted supernatant was filtered through a 0.22 µm polyethersulfone filter (Nalgene) to minimize contamination from larger vesicles.
inferred: To isolate exomeres, the supernatant obtained from the final centrifugation step of 167k EV isolation was subjected to ultracentrifugation at 167,000 g for 16 h at 4°C.
inferred: To isolate supermeres, the supernatant obtained after exomere isolation was further ultracentrifuged at 367,000 g for 16 h at 4°C using an SW55 Ti rotor.
